# Mapping Africa — 2019

> Benchmark chips for Africa (Mapping Africa sites) cut from the 2019 edition of the harmonized field boundary collection lacuna.

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2019/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2019/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2019/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2019/lacuna_2019_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2019/lacuna_2019_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2019/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2019/lacuna_2019_fields.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2019/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2019/items.parquet)
